where: Driftholm, the island town of the Farlamp Isles, cut off in the long dark for eleven winters
mood: A sea-town hymn in the long dark: warm but lonely, small lamps kept alone in the windows.
_motif_note: THE ANCHOR of the Farlamp family (music-cue-family skill): unconditioned; its theme is registered as motif-farlamp.json and the other four isles cues condition on it.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
3/4 time, a gentle rocking hymn pulse
D minor with a harmonic-minor leading note
a warm soft pulse-wave lead singing a slow seafaring hymn tune
sampled string pad holding hymn chords
a few soft glass bells at the ends of phrases like lamps in windows
a warm low bass note on each bar
a soft wash of surf under the music
warm but lonely, an island town keeping its lamps alone in the long night

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a soft wash of surf, then a single harp arpeggio in D minor and one glass bell, like a lamp lit in a window}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the hymn tune in D minor on a warm pulse-wave lead: a step up from the tonic, a drop to the fifth below, then three rising steps, phrases ending on long held notes over string chords}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hymn again, a soft flute answering each phrase, harp arpeggios turning beneath, bells at the phrase ends}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the tune lifts into F major, looking out to sea from the harbour wall, hopeful and wistful, then turns back to an A major chord}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the hymn returns in D minor, warm and steady; the last bar rises on a pickup straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
